meaning:
ἀδίκημα, -τος, τό
(ἀδικέω), [in LXX for עָוֹן, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;]
a wrong, injury, misdeed (MM, VGT, see word): Act.18:14 24:20, Rev.18:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable…
for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.
